notes: Создание ценностей, отличаемое в §211 от систематизации прежних оценок, описано здесь как ценностная задача идеала философа. Это реконструкция оценочного горизонта данного места, не одобрение его иерархии со стороны ToS и не числовое значение свойства.
preferred_label: Творческое полагание ценностей как задача — JGB 211

semantic_content.valuation_context: The discourse and ideal of JGB 211; this description does not adopt the valuation as ToS policy.
semantic_content.value_account: Creating values and determining ends is privileged as the distinct task of the philosopher described here, in contrast with formulating already prevailing valuations.

semantic_scope.identity_criterion: Retain this evaluative referent while the inquiry concerns the value placed on creating values in this passage; individual created values would be distinct subjects.
semantic_scope.scope_note: Creative valuation as valued within the ideal described in JGB 211, not all values or all of the author's commitments.

variant_labels.value: Creative valuation as a task — JGB 211
